verdict.rationale: Exporting data in open formats and leaving is a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no bulk data export, no open-format download, and no offboarding or data-portability feature. Audit-ready reports, live dashboards, and a titled 'Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs' page are adjacent features or developer building blocks rather than a documented full-data export capability.
